note: Synthetic HTTP responses written for tests/test_fingerprint_catalogue.py from public knowledge of each product's markers. None is a capture of a real host: header values, cookies and page fragments are trimmed to what the catalogue matches on, and example.test stands in for every name. 'also' lists the other technologies a fixture is expected to identify; 'version' and 'cpe' what the catalogue must extract. 'negatives' must identify nothing at all.

blog post that names the products
negatives.body:
Jenkins, GitLab, Gitea, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus, Zabbix and SonarQube consoles should not face the internet. Neither should phpMyAdmin, Adminer, pgAdmin, Webmin, cPanel or Plesk. We also check FortiGate SSL-VPN, Ivanti (Pulse) Connect Secure, Citrix Gateway, GlobalProtect, AnyConnect, Check Point and SonicWall portals, Exchange OWA, Zimbra and Roundcube webmail, MikroTik RouterOS and UserGate.

CMS fleets: WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, 1C-Bitrix, Magento, OpenCart, Tilda and MODX; the 1С:Предприятие web client; Elasticsearch, which answers 'You Know, for Search'; and a Spring Boot Whitelabel Error Page left on.

Kubernetes API servers that answer system:anonymous, Docker registries, Jupyter, Consul and Vault round it off. RD Web Access and OpenVPN Access Server too.
